sources.title: mypy — optional static checking separate from execution
sources.sections_read: README: What is mypy?, Quick start, Web site and documentation
sources.confirmed: Mypy checks Python types without executing the program, supports gradual typing, and allows code to run regardless of checker errors. The README links its documentation and release blog.
sources.limits: The checker does not itself change Python's definition-time evaluation or supply an arbitrary-metadata evaluator; storage and runtime access still require a separate mechanism. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C14.json.

sources.title: Effect — intent objects with separate performers
sources.sections_read: README: What Is It?, Example, Videos
sources.confirmed: Effect separates an arbitrary intent object from its execution by a dispatcher and performer. The README also links talks dated September 2015, but its currently displayed API is not itself a dated snapshot.
sources.limits: This is an analogy, not an annotation implementation; namespace capture, error timing, caching, and compatibility with existing annotation consumers still need a language-level design. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C14.json.
